name: KdaBwd

q.description: 查询张量, shape (B, T, H, K); bfloat16/float16

k.description: 键张量, shape (B, T, H, K); 与 q 同 dtype

v.description: 值张量, shape (B, T, HV, V); HV = H*G (GQA 扩展); float16/bfloat16

g.description: log 域衰减门控 (恒 ≤ 0), shape (B, T, HV, K); float32

beta.description: delta 规则门控 ((0,1)), shape (B, T, HV); bfloat16/float16

do.description: 输出梯度, shape (B, T, HV, V); 与 v 同 dtype

dht.description: 末状态梯度, shape (B, HV, K, V) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无

scale.description: q 缩放因子, float 标量

initial_state.description: 初始状态 h0, shape (B, HV, K, V) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无

dq.description: q 梯度, 同 q 形状与 dtype (GQA 组内求和收回 H 头)

dk.description: k 梯度, 同 k 形状与 dtype

dv.description: v 梯度, 同 v 形状与 dtype

dg.description: g 梯度, 同 g 形状与 dtype (float32)

dbeta.description: beta 梯度, 同 beta 形状与 dtype

dh0.description: 初始状态梯度, shape (B, HV, K, V) float32; 无 h0 时为空张量 [0, HV, K, V]

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(q, k, v, g, beta, do, dht, scale, initial_state):
    B, T, H, K = q.shape
    HV, V = v.shape[2], v.shape[3]
    G = HV // H

    qf, kf, vf = q.float(), k.float(), v.float()
    gf, bf = g.float(), beta.float()
    dof = do.float()

    q_exp = qf.repeat_interleave(G, dim=2) * scale
    k_exp = kf.repeat_interleave(G, dim=2)

    has_init = initial_state is not None and initial_state.shape[0] > 0
    has_dht = dht is not None and dht.shape[0] > 0

    S = qf.new_zeros(B, HV, K, V)
    if has_init:
        S = S + initial_state.float()

    S_dec_list = []
    v_new_list = []
    for t in range(T):
        k_t = k_exp[:, t]
        v_t = vf[:, t]
        g_t = gf[:, t]
        b_t = bf[:, t]

        S_dec = S * g_t.unsqueeze(-1).exp()
        v_new = v_t - (S_dec.transpose(-2, -1) @ k_t.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        S = S_dec + b_t.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1) * k_t.unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)

        S_dec_list.append(S_dec)
        v_new_list.append(v_new)

    S_dec_stack = torch.stack(S_dec_list, dim=0)
    v_new_stack = torch.stack(v_new_list, dim=0)

    dq_exp = torch.zeros_like(q_exp)
    dk_exp = torch.zeros_like(k_exp)
    dv = torch.zeros_like(vf)
    dg = torch.zeros_like(gf)
    dbeta = torch.zeros_like(bf)

    if has_dht:
        dS = dht.float().clone()
    else:
        dS = torch.zeros(B, HV, K, V, device=q.device)
    for t in range(T - 1, -1, -1):
        S_dec = S_dec_stack[t]
        v_new = v_new_stack[t]

        beta_t = bf[:, t]
        k_t = k_exp[:, t]
        S_t = S_dec + beta_t.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1) * k_t.unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)
        do_t = dof[:, t]
        dq_exp[:, t] = scale * (S_t @ do_t.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        dS = dS + scale * q_exp[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * do_t.unsqueeze(-2)
        dk_exp[:, t] = beta_t.unsqueeze(-1) * (dS @ v_new.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        dv_new = beta_t.unsqueeze(-1) * (dS.transpose(-2, -1) @ k_t.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        dbeta[:, t] = (dS * (k_t.unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2))).sum(dim=(-2, -1))
        dv[:, t] = dv_new
        dS_dec = dS - k_t.unsqueeze(-1) * dv_new.unsqueeze(-2)
        g_t = gf[:, t]
        dg[:, t] = (dS_dec * S_dec).sum(dim=-1)
        dS = dS_dec * g_t.unsqueeze(-1).exp()

    dq = dq_exp.reshape(B, T, H, G, K).sum(dim=3)
    dk = dk_exp.reshape(B, T, H, G, K).sum(dim=3)

    if has_init:
        dh0 = dS
    else:
        dh0 = torch.empty(0, HV, K, V, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    return (dq.to(q.dtype), dk.to(k.dtype), dv.to(v.dtype),
            dg.to(g.dtype), dbeta.to(beta.dtype), dh0)
description:
chunk_kda 反向 —— KDA 门控 delta 规则线性注意力的梯度 golden reference, 显式反向公式。
数学语义:
  前向 (fp32): S ← S·exp(g_t); S ← S + (β_t k_t)⊗(v_t − S^T k_t); o_t = S^T q_t
  损失: L = <o, do> + <final_state, dht>
  反向递推 (从 T-1 到 0): dS 初始化为 dht (若存在) 或零, 对每个 t:
    S_t = S_dec_t + β_t * k_t ⊗ v_new_t
    dq_t = scale * (S_t @ do_t)
    dS += scale * q_t ⊗ do_t
    dk_t += β_t * (dS @ v_new_t)
    dv_new = β_t * (dS^T @ k_t)
    dβ_t = (dS * (k_t ⊗ v_new_t)).sum()
    dv_t = dv_new
    dS_dec = dS - k_t ⊗ dv_new
    dg_t = (dS_dec * S_dec_t).sum(dim=-1)
    dS = dS_dec * exp(g_t)
  dh0 = 递推结束时的 dS (若 h0 存在, 否则为空张量)
q/k 在 forward 中经 GQA 扩展 (repeat_interleave(G, dim=2)), q 预乘 scale; dq/dk 最终按组求和收回 (B,T,H,K)。
reference 在 run() 内先重算前向递推得到每步 S_dec/v_new 中间量, 再执行反向, solution 同样只接收叶子输入, 需自行重算前向中间量。
输入约束: g 为 log 域衰减, 生成范围 uniform(-1, -0.02) (真实场景为 logsigmoid 输出, 恒负); beta 生成范围 uniform(0, 1); q/k 生成范围 uniform(-0.05, 0.05) —— 真实场景 q/k 为 L2 归一化向量, 此处以小量级保证 delta 规则递推的擦除反馈因子 |1 - β·|k|²| < 1 (大随机值会导致状态指数爆炸)。
